newsitem.title: USA: ATHLETICS-ARBITRATOR REINSTATES SUSPENDED U.S. HURDLER.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-ARBITRATOR REINSTATES SUSPENDED U.S. HURDLER.

text.p: An arbitrator has ordered suspended U.S. 400-meter hurdler Stephon Flenoy be allowed to compete in the national championships, his attorney said Wednesday.
"After a full day's hearing, the arbitrator ruled that he (Flenoy) did not get a fair hearing before a USA Track and Field custodial board," Flenoy's attorney, Ed Williams, said.
"He ordered that USA Track and Field reinstate him in the competition."

Flenoy had been suspended by U.S. officials after a doping test revealed he had a testosterone to epitestosterone ratio higher than 6-to-1 in violation of IAAF rules. Because of the suspension he had been declared ineligible for the U.S. championships.
